prompt: Complete AlignedReceiptWriter.render so it prints an aligned receipt through a PrintWriter wrapped around a StringWriter and returns the accumulated text.
explanation: StringWriter is a Writer that keeps everything in memory, so wrapping a PrintWriter around it gives you the whole printf/println API while capturing the output as a String instead of sending it anywhere. PrintWriter buffers, so flush() before reading toString(). Passing Locale.US explicitly matters: without it %8.2f would use the platform's decimal separator and could print a comma instead of a point.
hints: new PrintWriter(stringWriter) gives you printf; the text lands in the StringWriter you passed in.
Accumulate the grand total as you loop, and remember the TOTAL line's quantity column holds items.size(), not the summed quantities.
